FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation

分类方向评测与可靠性 / 评测体系主题evaluation / benchmarks
Shengyi Wang, Niantong Li, Guangzheng Hu, Hong Qi, Fei Ding, Weixu Qiao et al.
high · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 它把视频生成评测从通用的画面质量、文本一致性和时间平滑度，推进到由专业电影语言定义的镜头与动态美学评估；对训练或选择文生视频、参考生视频模型的研究者尤其有用，因为领先模型在该基准上的得分明显低于网页风格基准，并且从单镜头到多镜头存在稳定性能下降。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 3）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有基准主要衡量基本的视频合理性，而非专业电影制作所要求的电影语言。

02
方法

基准从获奖影片中反向构造真实镜头表提示词，并用三层电影语言分类体系和专家级自动评测代理评分。

03
差异

它覆盖二十种电影类型，包含一千零五十六个多镜头提示词，并新增三十五项文生视频和三项参考生视频细分指标。

04
证据

自动评测复现人工模型排序，文生视频和参考生视频的模型级斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为零点九五和零点九六。

摘要

现有视频生成基准多采用网络或语言模型生成的提示词，并用未经专门训练的通用多模态模型评分，难以衡量电影制作中的专业语言与电影级技艺。该工作构建了电影级文生视频和参考生视频基准：提示词来自专业导演选定的获奖影片片段，覆盖二十种电影类型且大多数包含多镜头；评测采用包含三条轴、十二个组件和三十五项文生视频及三项参考生视频指标的电影语言分类体系，并配套专家级自动评测代理。对九个文生视频模型和七个参考生视频模型的测试显示，自动评测与人工模型排名高度一致，模型级斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为零点九五和零点九六；模型在动态美学和多镜头生成上的表现仍有明显缺口。

为什么值得看 这项工作把长期记忆失败拆成存储缺失、桥接知识缺失和检索未触发三类，并显示主要瓶颈在查询条件化的记忆接口：记忆显式放入上下文时回答率为百分之八十四，而交给六种向量、图和智能体记忆系统检索时最高仅为百分之十四点四。对设计智能体记忆、路由和持久可见信息的研究者，它说明单纯增大嵌入维度并不能解决隐含关联，值得优先研究哪些事实应保持可见。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 13）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有记忆评测难以区分记忆缺失、桥接知识缺失与记忆检索失败。

02
方法

基准包含十个生活领域的百二十五项专家核验任务，并用配对控制隔离三种失败原因。

03
差异

它测试查询与所需记忆没有表面线索的间接关联，而不是只测试相似文本的记忆召回。

04
证据

六种记忆系统在按需检索时的间接查询表现最高为百分之十四点四，而显式提供记忆时骨干模型达到百分之八十四；八倍嵌入维度未消除差距。

摘要

长期记忆系统通常把用户陈述存入外部存储，并在收到相关查询时检索；这种接口默认需要的记忆应当与查询相似，但世界知识会打破这一假设，例如树坚果过敏应通过杏仁粉这一成分影响对马卡龙的回答。作者引入隐含关联盲点及其基准，包含十个生活领域的百二十五项任务，其中百一十三项有可引用的公开来源；配对控制实验区分事实未存储、模型缺少桥接知识和事实已存储但未被唤回三种原因，结果显示检索接口是主要失效位置。

Junlin Fang, Do Nguyen-Thanh, Xiaogang Xu, Zhen Fang, Sean Du
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把长推理轨迹中的无关步骤和重复步骤视为幻觉检测的噪声，并用最终答案对步骤表示提供自动监督；对依赖推理过程信号的检测器而言，它提供了一个可插拔的轨迹清洗层，而不是继续依赖不稳定的置信度或朴素嵌入筛选。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 6）
方法解读
01
问题

长推理轨迹中的无关步骤和重复步骤会显著削弱幻觉检测，而现有置信度分数和朴素嵌入筛选难以区分噪声与有效步骤。

02
方法

方法利用最终答案注意力作为自动监督，学习步骤级表示并过滤被识别为噪声的推理步骤。

03
差异

它在检测器处理轨迹之前增加可插拔的推理去噪层，而不是直接对完整轨迹使用置信度或嵌入筛选。

04
证据

作者报告在多个推理基准上，相比有竞争力的基线，该方法持续提升幻觉检测性能。

摘要

大型推理模型通常会在给出最终答案前生成很长的推理轨迹，这些轨迹虽包含幻觉检测信号，却常被无关步骤和重复步骤掩盖。本文提出一种利用最终答案注意力塑造步骤级表示空间的学习方法，以识别并移除噪声步骤；在多个推理基准上的实验表明，该方法能持续提升多种幻觉检测器的检测性能。

high · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 这项工作把相关性从静态的前置筛选信号变成语料库交互时的执行先验：它先访问更可能有用的文档，用相关段落初始化搜索入口，再把更有信息量的匹配片段置于大语言模型之前。对于需要定位、组合和核验证据的复杂浏览问答，这补上了仅靠前若干文档或无关性感知的检索式搜索容易收敛慢的缺口；文中称其在困难浏览问答和推理密集型检索上改善了准确率与效率的权衡。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 42）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

仅按文档相关性截取内容会遗漏细粒度证据，而无关性感知的搜索可能较晚发现关键线索。

02
方法

该代理按相关性顺序遍历文档，以相关段落设置搜索入口，并对搜索匹配片段重新排序。

03
差异

它把相关性持续用于交互执行，而不只用于交互开始前的语料库缩小。

04
证据

在困难浏览问答和推理密集型检索上，论文称其优于检索代理和直接交互代理的准确率与效率前沿。

摘要

相关性通常用于选择前若干文档，但复杂问题还需要在语料库中定位、组合和核验证据；直接语料库交互虽然支持细粒度搜索，却可能较晚暴露有用线索。本文将相关性转化为语料库交互的执行先验，通过按序遍历文档、用相关段落初始化入口并重新排序搜索匹配结果，在困难浏览问答和推理密集型检索中改善了准确率与效率的权衡。

StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 推理与规划主题tool use / agent workflow
Yan Yang, Xiangru Jian, Ziyang Luo, Zirui Zhao, Yutong Dai, Ziji Shi et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把长程计算机操作代理的主要接口从截图转向文件、应用后端和网页文档对象模型等程序状态，并将图形界面保留给少数必须点击的子目标；对研究代理推理、工具调用和可靠执行的人来说，它提供了比单纯提升视觉感知更直接的系统设计方向。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 53）
方法解读
01
问题

截图无法完整区分底层程序状态，也难以可靠验证文件是否保存或写入正确路径。

02
方法

主代理用代码访问程序状态，并把必要的图形界面操作、完成检查和子目标执行分别交给专用子代理。

03
差异

系统不采用纯代码方案，而是仅在一百零八项任务中的二十八项、主代理步骤的百分之一点一中调用图形界面子代理。

04
证据

在操作系统世界二点零上，系统的二元成功率为百分之二十六点九、部分成功率为百分之六十一点六；纯代码变体的部分成功率仅为百分之四十五点九。

摘要

计算机操作代理通常通过改进截图理解和点击定位来提升性能，但截图只是程序状态的有损呈现，不同状态可能产生相同像素，而代码可以直接检查和修改文件、应用后端及网页文档对象模型。状态行动是一个以代码为先的多代理系统：主代理直接操作程序状态，专门的图形界面子代理只处理少数需要截图和点击的子目标，并通过独立的完成检查器验证结果是否存在结构性错误；在操作系统世界二点零上，它将克劳德奥普斯四点八的二元成功率从百分之二十点六提升至百分之二十六点九，部分成功率从百分之五十四点八提升至百分之六十一点六，同时每项任务成本约降低至截图驱动版本的九分之一。

为什么值得看 该方法把工业异常检测从依赖正常视频再训练或测试时注入领域知识，转向无需训练的对象中心时空推理；它尤其适合对象变换复杂、物理规则严格且流程约束强的制造场景，并能输出异常过程与类型的可解释报告。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 9）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

工业场景中的异常检测需要处理对象的复杂交互、状态变化以及严格的物理和流程约束。

02
方法

框架跟踪检测对象的空间时间动态和潜在变换，再根据对象级时序状态轨迹定位异常对象及其对应画面。

03
差异

方法无需训练或领域专用知识，避免了在正常片段上重新训练以及在测试时注入领域上下文。

04
证据

摘要称其在三个工业视频异常检测数据集上超过前沿视觉语言模型、智能体框架和相应数据集微调的传统方法，并提供可解释报告。

摘要

工业视频异常检测旨在识别工业流程中的异常对象和事件，但现有基于视觉语言模型的方法在对象变换复杂、物理规则严格且流程约束强的工业环境中性能下降。本文提出一种无需训练且不依赖领域知识的智能体式框架，像人工检验员一样跟踪对象状态随时间的演化，利用对象级时序状态轨迹推理异常对象及其所在画面；在三个工业视频异常检测数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于前沿视觉语言模型、智能体框架以及在相应数据集上微调的传统视频异常检测方法，并能生成可解释的异常过程与类型报告。

The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 推理与规划主题reasoning / planning
Tianyi Men, Zhuoran Jin, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
high · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 这项工作把多轮长视野规划拆成预训练中的能力获得、后训练中的能力塑造与多环境中的能力整合，并用可控环境分析误差累积、世界模型构建和跨环境干扰。对训练智能体的研究者而言，它提供了比直接依赖互联网轨迹更可诊断的训练路径，并指出在低质量长轨迹下，单教师在策略蒸馏中的效果可能不如多教师在策略蒸馏。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 21）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

研究者缺少能够控制数据、轨迹质量和环境差异的统一设置来解释长视野规划的形成与迁移。

02
方法

作者在统一的多轮环境中分别研究预训练数据、群体相对策略优化、在线策略蒸馏和多教师在线策略蒸馏。

03
差异

方法将规划模式与任务特定知识分开分析，并把多教师蒸馏用于跨环境能力整合，而不只进行单任务后训练。

04
证据

实验声称显式状态转移建模增强长视野泛化，在线策略蒸馏在低质量长视野条件下比群体相对策略优化拥有更广的有效区域。

摘要

多轮长视野规划对基础模型智能体至关重要，但其能力如何获得、塑造和整合仍不清楚。本文引入统一且可控的多轮环境，系统研究三个阶段：预训练中通过显式的思维链状态转移建模构建世界模型，后训练中比较群体相对策略优化与在线策略蒸馏对规划模式和任务知识的作用，以及通过多教师在线策略蒸馏整合不同环境中的规划能力。结果显示，少量长视野数据有助于组合泛化，而次优轨迹会因长程误差累积严重损害性能；在低质量和长视野设置下，在线策略蒸馏的有效范围比群体相对策略优化更广，多教师蒸馏能整合兼容的规划模式，但完全冲突的模式会造成严重干扰。

Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model

分类方向模型与训练方法 / 架构设计主题multimodal / VLM architecture
Senqiao Yang, Kaichen Zhang, Zhaoyang Jia, Jinghao Guo, Yifei Shen, Xinjie Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对视觉语言模型在实时视频感知中的低效率：通过利用视频编解码器的运动向量和残差能量，只编码动态且信息量高的区域，在保留时空上下文的同时将视觉标记消耗降低超过百分之七十五。论文还把轻量级事件门控与因果解码器结合，使模型能主动处理流式输入；摘要声称其四十亿参数版本在静态任务上匹配同规模基线，并在视频理解和二维、三维空间推理上取得提升，推理墙钟时间最高加速三点五倍。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有视觉语言模型在流式视觉感知中会因均匀抽帧和高视觉标记开销而处理低效。

02
方法

视觉标记器利用运动向量与残差能量选择性编码锚帧和预测帧中的动态区域，并由事件门控和因果解码器处理连续输入。

03
差异

该方法把视频编解码信号直接用于视觉标记选择，而不是依赖固定帧采样，并采用轻量级前置感知系统触发后续推理。

04
证据

摘要报告视觉标记消耗降低超过百分之七十五、最高三点五倍推理加速，以及在视频理解和空间推理上的提升。

摘要

FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Shengyi Wang, Niantong Li, Guangzheng Hu, Hong Qi, Fei Ding, Weixu Qiao et al.
high · 2026-07-27

Why it matters FilmBench gives video-generation researchers a stricter test of cinematic craft than generic visual-quality and text-alignment scores. It is useful for training or selecting text-to-video and reference-to-video systems because leading models score substantially lower than on web-style benchmarks, with persistent weaknesses in dynamic aesthetics and a larger drop when moving from single-shot to multi-shot generation.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 3)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing benchmarks mostly measure basic video plausibility rather than the cinematic language used in professional filmmaking.

02
Method

The benchmark reverse-engineers shot-list prompts from award-winning film clips and scores them with a three-level cinematic taxonomy plus an expert-grade automatic evaluation agent.

03
Difference

It covers 20 genres, includes 1,056 multi-shot prompts, and defines 35 text-to-video and 3 reference-to-video sub-metrics.

04
Evidence

The automatic evaluator matches human model rankings with model-level Spearman correlations of 0.95 for text-to-video and 0.96 for reference-to-video.

Abstract

Progress in video generation keeps narrowing the visual gap between AI-generated and professionally produced footage, yet most benchmarks still draw prompts from web sources or LLM templates and score them with untrained, generic multimodal models. More fundamentally, their evaluation taxonomies remain rudimentary (overall visual quality, coarse text alignment and temporal smoothness) rather than the professional Cinematic Language criteria by which films are actually made and judged, so they assess basic video plausibility rather than film-grade craft. We introduce FilmBench, a text-to-video (T2V) and reference-to-video (R2V) benchmark grounded in the professional Cinematic Language of the film- academy tradition and co-developed with directors and faculty from the Beijing Film Academy and the Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group film studio. It rests on three choices. First, prompts are reverse-engineered from clips of award-winning films spanning 20 cinematic genres and chosen by professional directors, so every prompt is anchored to a verified live-action reference; the prompts follow real shot lists, and most script multiple shots (1,056 of the 1,169 prompts are multi-shot), unlike prior single-clip benchmarks. Second, evaluation follows a three-level Cinematic taxonomy of 3 axes, 12 components and 35 (T2V) +3 (R2V-only) sub-metrics. Third, we develop an in-house expert-grade automatic evaluation agent and open-source its core suite of Cinematic Language operators (FilmOps). Benchmarking leading video generation models (9 for T2V, 7 for R2V), the evaluator reproduces the human model ranking at model-level Spearman ho = 0.95 (T2V) and 0.96 (R2V). Scores fall well below prior web-style benchmarks, with two consistent gaps in dynamic aesthetics and a marked single- to multi-shot performance drop that widens for weaker models.

Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Ruizhe Li, Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Zhendong Mao
high · 2026-07-27

Why it matters This paper separates long-term-memory failures into missing storage, missing bridging knowledge, and failed retrieval, and shows that the main bottleneck is the query-conditioned memory interface: explicit context yields 84.0% accuracy, while six vector, graph, and agentic systems reach at most 14.4% when they must retrieve the memory. For researchers building agent memory, routing, and persistent visibility policies, the result argues that simply increasing embedding dimensionality is insufficient and that deciding which facts remain visible deserves direct optimization and evaluation.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 13)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing memory evaluations conflate absent memories, absent bridging knowledge, and retrieval failures.

02
Method

The benchmark uses 125 expert-verified tasks across ten life domains and paired controls to isolate these three causes.

03
Difference

It evaluates indirect associations in which the needed memory shares no visible query cue, rather than only testing similarity-based recall.

04
Evidence

The six systems reach at most 14.4% on indirect queries with retrieval, versus 84.0% when the decisive memory is visible; an eightfold larger embedding leaves the gap essentially intact.

Abstract

Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.

Reasoning Denoiser: Denoising Reasoning Traces for Hallucination Detection in Large Reasoning Models

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Junlin Fang, Do Nguyen-Thanh, Xiaogang Xu, Zhen Fang, Sean Du
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters The paper treats irrelevant and repetitive steps as structured noise in long reasoning traces and uses final-answer attention to supervise step representations. For detectors that rely on reasoning-process signals, this offers a plug-in trajectory-cleaning layer instead of relying on unreliable confidence scores or naive embedding filters.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 6)
Method brief
01
Problem

Irrelevant and repetitive steps substantially hurt hallucination detection, while existing confidence scores and naive embedding filters do not reliably separate noisy from informative steps.

02
Method

REDE uses final-answer attention as automatic supervision to learn step-level representations and remove identified noisy steps before detection.

03
Difference

It adds a detector-agnostic denoising stage over the reasoning trajectory rather than scoring the complete trace with confidence or simple embedding heuristics.

04
Evidence

The paper reports consistent detection gains over competitive baselines across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

Abstract

Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces before producing final answers. While these traces may contain useful signals for hallucination detection, harnessing them is non-trivial because long trajectories often include noisy steps that obscure the cues relevant to truthfulness assessment. In this paper, we identify two prevalent forms of reasoning noises, i.e., irrelevant steps and repetitive steps, and show that both substantially degrade hallucination detection performance. Existing confidence-based scores and naive embedding-based filtering fail to reliably separate noisy from informative steps. To address this challenge, we propose REDE, a novel learning framework for denoising reasoning traces for hallucination detection. Specifically, REDE leverages final-answer attention as an automatic supervision signal to shape the step-level representation space, yielding refined embeddings in which noisy steps can be reliably identified and filtered. REDE can be readily plugged into diverse hallucination detectors by operating on the filtered reasoning trajectory after removing noisy steps. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that REDE consistently improves detection performance over competitive baselines.

A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Jiangnan Li, Yuqing Li, Mo Yu, Jinchao Zhang, Jie Zhou
high · 2026-07-27

Why it matters This work turns relevance from a static top-k filter into an execution prior for corpus interaction: the agent visits likely-useful documents first, seeds searches with relevant paragraphs, and surfaces informative matches before the language model. For complex browse-based QA that requires locating, composing, and verifying evidence, this addresses the slow convergence of top-k retrieval and relevance-agnostic grep-style search; the paper reports a better accuracy-efficiency frontier on challenging browse QA and reasoning-intensive retrieval.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 42)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Document-level relevance filtering misses fine-grained evidence, while relevance-agnostic interaction may reveal useful clues too late.

02
Method

The agent orders documents for sequential ripgrep traversal, initializes entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches.

03
Difference

It uses relevance throughout interaction execution rather than only to shrink the corpus before interaction starts.

04
Evidence

The paper reports improved accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents on challenging browse QA and reasoning-intensive retrieval.

Abstract

Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-k content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.

StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Yan Yang, Xiangru Jian, Ziyang Luo, Zirui Zhao, Yutong Dai, Ziji Shi et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters The paper moves long-horizon computer-use agents from screenshot-centric control toward direct access to files, application backends, and the DOM, while retaining GUI interaction for the few subtasks that require it. For researchers in agent reasoning and tool use, this offers a concrete alternative to treating better visual perception as the main route to reliability and efficiency.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 53)
Method brief
01
Problem

Screenshots lose information about program state and cannot reliably expose structural failures such as unsaved or misplaced output.

02
Method

The main agent uses code to inspect and modify program state, while separate subagents handle GUI actions, finish verification, and delegated subtasks.

03
Difference

The system is hybrid rather than code-only, invoking its GUI subagent on 28 of 108 tasks and for 1.1% of main-agent steps.

04
Evidence

On OSWorld 2.0, it reaches 26.9% binary success and 61.6% partial success, whereas its code-only variant reaches 45.9% partial success.

Abstract

Computer-use agents are usually improved by strengthening perception: better models for reading a screenshot and choosing where to click. Yet a screenshot is only a lossy rendering of the underlying program state, e.g., the files, application backends, and DOM that hold the task data. Different states can produce the same pixels, while code can inspect and modify that state directly. StateAct is a code-first, multi-agent harness built around this distinction. Its main agent works directly with program state by using code, while a dedicated GUI subagent handles screenshot-and-click interaction on the few subgoals that need it, just 28 of 108 tasks and 1.1% of main-agent steps. The same direct access to program state also supports verification: an independent finish gate double-checks the saved result for structural failures, e.g., output that is missing, unsaved, or written to the wrong path. To stay on track over hundreds of steps, the main agent hands subgoals to fresh subagents, keeping its own context focused. On OSWorld 2.0, StateAct lifts Claude Opus 4.8 from 20.6% to 26.9% on binary success, and from 54.8% to 61.6% on partial success, at ~ 9x lower cost per task than the same model driven by screenshots alone; a code-only variant with no GUI subagent reaches only 45.9% partial, below that screenshot-based baseline's 54.8%. In general, grounding action, verification, and memory in state, what we call state-grounding, shifts the main bottleneck from perception toward reasoning: failures depend more on what the agent thinks than on what it sees.

Why it matters The method shifts industrial anomaly detection from retraining on normal clips or adding domain context at test time to training-free, object-centric temporal reasoning. Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 9)

Method brief
01
Problem

Industrial anomaly detection must handle complex object interactions, state changes, physical rules, and procedural constraints.

02
Method

The framework tracks detected objects' spatiotemporal dynamics and transformations, then reasons over object-wise temporal state trajectories to localize abnormal objects in grounded frames.

03
Difference

It requires neither retraining nor domain-specific knowledge, unlike approaches based on normal-clip training or test-time domain context.

Abstract

Industrial Video Anomaly Detection (IVAD) aims to identify anomalous objects and events in an industrial process, which is crucial for modern manufacturing and quality control systems. Existing VLM-based anomaly reasoning methods are capable of detecting open-ended anomalies in general domains. However, their performance declines in industrial settings characterized by intricate object transformations, strict physics, and procedural constraints. To tackle the complexity of such interaction-intensive detection, we introduce a training-free agentic framework for anomaly detection free of domain-specific knowledge, emphasizing object state evolution like humans inspectors. It is designed to track spatial-temporal dynamics and underlying transformations of detected objects over time, and then reason over the object-wise temporal state trajectories to identify abnormal objects in grounded frames. Our method overcomes limitations of prior approaches that rely on retraining on normal clips or injecting domain knowledge as context for test-time inference. Extensive experiments on three IVAD datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms frontier VLMs, agentic frameworks, and traditional VAD methods fine-tuned on the respective datasets, while providing interpretable reports over anomaly processes and types.

The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopicreasoning / planning
Tianyi Men, Zhuoran Jin, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
high · 2026-07-27

Why it matters This paper gives agent-training researchers a controlled way to separate planning acquisition, shaping, and integration instead of inferring them from opaque Internet trajectories. Its findings connect long-horizon failures to weak world-model construction and error amplification, and indicate that on-policy distillation can be more reliable than GRPO in low-quality, long-horizon settings, while multi-teacher distillation trades capability integration against interference.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 21)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Long-horizon planning is difficult to study because training data and trajectory quality are usually uncontrollable and opaque.

02
Method

The paper uses a unified multi-turn environment to analyze pre-training data, GRPO, OPD, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation across controlled tasks.

03
Difference

It separates general planning patterns from task-specific knowledge and studies their cross-environment integration through MOPD.

04
Evidence

The reported results link explicit state-transition modeling to stronger long-horizon generalization, find a broader effective region for OPD than GRPO in low-quality long-horizon settings, and report severe interference between conflicting planning patterns.

Abstract

Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. 01 / 论文

📄 论文

方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference

01
论文 / 重点关注

The SpiNNaker2 chip: a many-core platform for flexible and scalable brain-inspired computing

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Stefan Scholze, Johannes Partzsch, Sebastian Höppner, Florian Kelber, Andreas Dixius, Marco Stolba et al.
medium · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 这是一种面向神经形态计算与深度网络混合部署的多核加速器平台：它把事件驱动通信、专用加速器、片外内存和以太网集成到同一芯片中，适合研究稀疏推理、脉冲网络及边缘设备上的低功耗计算。芯片在整数八位工作负载上宣称最高每秒四点五万亿次运算和每瓦二点七万亿次运算，并支持超过十五万个神经元，可作为通用加速器和系统集成的硬件参考。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文针对深度网络效率压力以及神经形态计算与主流深度网络之间缺少统一硬件平台的问题。

02
方法

芯片采用一百五十二个处理单元、专用加速器、可扩展事件路由网络、外部内存和系统接口来支持多种计算模式。

03
差异

平台同时覆盖脉冲网络、深度网络和事件驱动方法，而不是只针对单一网络或单一计算范式。

04
证据

实验报告了整数八位深度网络最高每秒四点五万亿次运算、每瓦二点七万亿次运算，以及每毫秒时间步超过十八亿次突触事件。

摘要

随着模型规模和应用持续增长，深度学习需要更高的效率，神经形态硬件因此受到关注。斯皮内克二代芯片包含一百五十二个配备臂架构微控制器和专用加速器的处理单元、可扩展的事件通信网络，以及千兆以太网和低功耗双倍数据率内存等外部接口；论文展示了其在神经形态和深度网络工作负载上的性能，并报告了整数八位工作负载最高每秒四点五万亿次运算、最高每瓦二点七万亿次运算、超过十五万个神经元和每秒十八亿次以上突触事件的能力。

潜力 36新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
12 位作者2 所机构29 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

At-the-Roofline Sparse Tensor Contractions on Vector Processors for Transformer Inference

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Bowen Wang, Chi Zhang, Diyou Shen, Renzo Andri, Navaneeth Kunhi Purayil, Luca Benini
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对稀疏变换器推理的向量处理器瓶颈，用硬件化的索引聚合与散射支持替代软件索引解码；在百分之四十至百分之六十双重稀疏度下，它为预填充带来二点四零至五点二五倍加速、为自回归解码带来二点零六至三点一六倍加速，并仅增加百分之三点一的集群面积。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有向量架构依赖软件索引解码以及由一级缓存支持的索引内存操作，难以高效执行中等稀疏度下的权重和激活联合稀疏收缩。

02
方法

文塔廖通过可运行时配置的稀疏执行单元和向量指令集扩展，提供索引聚集、累加与散射操作。

03
差异

该设计把古斯塔夫森数据流中的关键索引操作从软件内核移到紧耦合向量处理集群的硬件中。

04
证据

论文给出十二纳米实现、指令级性能模型及其寄存器传输级校准，并报告相较优化向量基线六点九至七点四倍的稀疏内核加速。

摘要

细粒度权重剪枝和激活稀疏化可以降低变换器推理的计算与内存成本，但现有向量处理器缺少对古斯塔夫森数据流所需索引累加模式的原生支持，导致稀疏张量收缩远低于屋顶线性能。本文提出文塔廖稀疏执行单元及相应的向量指令集扩展，并在十二纳米工艺的开源向量处理集群中实现；相较优化后的向量基线，内核加速达到六点九至七点四倍，在采用双重稀疏的拉玛三八十亿参数模型上，预填充和自回归解码分别达到二点四零至五点二五倍和二点零六至三点一六倍的密集基线加速。

潜力 30新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
6 位作者0 所机构5 条合作线
03
论文 / 高优先级

MDTransformer: A Hardware-Software Co-Design of Mode-Division Photonic Transformer Accelerator with Inverse-Designed Coherent Crossbar

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Solomon Micheal Serunjogi, Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, Ayat Taha, Muhammad Shafique, Mahmoud Rasras
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 这项工作直接面向变换器推理加速器的硬件瓶颈：用四个空间模式作为独立计算通道，减少对多波长光源、光谱滤波和大型点积单元的依赖，并支持单激光连续波运行。对研究光子推理芯片、低能耗边缘推理和软硬件协同设计的读者，它报告了相对现有光子变换器加速器面积降低百分之四十点四、功耗降低百分之六十三点六、能耗降低百分之四十点六且延迟相当。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有光子变换器加速器需要多波长光源和大型点积单元，并受到有源移相器带来的效率与实用性限制。

02
方法

该方法将多模耦合器、交叉器和同相正交调制器组成模式分复用光子张量核心，并用相干探测与同相正交调制执行复数矩阵运算。

03
差异

每条波导中的四个导模提供四路并行计算，不需要光谱滤波或受自由光谱范围限制，并兼容一台一五五零纳米单激光连续波光源。

04
证据

实验报告称其有效精度低于四位、模间串扰低于负三十分贝，并在多种视觉与语言变换器负载上实现面积、功耗和能耗下降且延迟相当。

摘要

现有光子变换器加速器虽然能提升变换器推理的速度和能效，但依赖昂贵的多波长光源和由有源移相器构成的大型点积单元，因此效率和实用性受限。本文提出一种基于模式分复用光学数据流的软硬件协同设计，利用逆向设计的多模耦合器、交叉器和马赫曾德尔同相正交调制器构成紧凑的模式分复用光子张量核心，以空间模式干涉执行光学矩阵乘法；实验表明，在多种视觉和语言变换器负载上，该方案相较现有光子变换器加速器可降低百分之四十点四的面积、百分之六十三点六的功耗和百分之四十点六的能耗，同时保持相当延迟。

潜力 30新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
5 位作者0 所机构4 条合作线

方向推理系统 / 内存与解码优化主题quantization / compression

04
论文 / 补充信号

dRAE: Representation Autoencoder with Hyper-Spherical Codes

分类方向推理系统 / 内存与解码优化主题quantization / compression
Tianren Ma, Lin Long, Chuyan Chen, Mu Zhang, Junbo Zhao, Tong Zhang et al.
low · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作主要服务于视觉表示离散化和视觉语言接口，而不是训练集群或推理服务本身；但它为需要大词表离散视觉表示的系统提供了可扩展的码本方案，尤其适合关注表示压缩与多模态输入管线的研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 9）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有欧氏距离码本目标会产生幅值尺度差异和不均匀角度分布，导致码本坍塌并限制扩展。

02
方法

超球面量化使用基于角度的路由分配码字，从而把语义内容与特征幅值分离。

03
差异

该方法不再让特征尺度主导码字分配，并据此构建离散表示自编码器。

04
证据

扩散变换器是高质量视频生成的关键，但长标记序列使注意力成为主要推理瓶颈。本文提出无需训练的在线稀疏注意力方法，通过在在线软最大值计算中按块阈值筛选并复用代理分数，在不显式生成代理分数图的情况下实现可控的动态块预算，并近似补偿未选块的贡献；图像和视频生成实验表明，该方法在保持视觉质量的同时改善了训练无关稀疏注意力的质量与效率折中，并为视频生成和编辑带来二点一倍与二点三倍端到端加速。

The SpiNNaker2 chip: a many-core platform for flexible and scalable brain-inspired computing

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Stefan Scholze, Johannes Partzsch, Sebastian Höppner, Florian Kelber, Andreas Dixius, Marco Stolba et al.
medium · 2026-07-27

Why it matters This is a hardware platform for combining neuromorphic and deep-network workloads: it integrates event-driven routing, dedicated accelerators, external memory, and Ethernet on one many-core chip. That makes it relevant to researchers evaluating sparse inference, spiking models, and low-power edge systems rather than only conventional GPU execution. The paper reports up to 4.5 TOPS and 2.7 TOPS/W for INT8 workloads, plus support for more than 150,000 neurons.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The paper addresses rising efficiency demands in deep learning and the lack of a flexible platform spanning deep networks and neuromorphic computing.

02
Method

The chip combines 152 processing elements, dedicated accelerators, scalable event-based routing, external memory, and system-integration interfaces.

03
Difference

It supports spiking networks, deep networks, and event-based approaches on the same many-core platform instead of targeting one computation style.

04
Evidence

The reported demonstrations include up to 4.5 TOPS, 2.7 TOPS/W for INT8 workloads, more than 150,000 neurons, and over 1.8 billion synaptic events per second.

Abstract

In deep learning, efficiency gets more and more important to compensate for the ongoing growth in model sizes and applications. Neuromorphic hardware has long been advocated as an upcoming alternative to deep networks, taking inspiration from the brain for achieving unprecedented energy efficiency. However, demonstrations of these gains only recently began to grow in complexity and real-world applicability. With SpiNNaker2, we present a chip that bridges the gap between deep networks and neuromorphic computing and allows for flexible exploration of computing approaches that combine both worlds. It features 152 processing elements equipped with an ARM M4F processor and dedicated accelerators, an extended SpiNNaker routing fabric for scalable event-based communication and a range of external interfaces for system integration, including Gbit Ethernet and an LPDDR4 memory interface. We demonstrate performance and efficiency of the SpiNNaker2 chip for neuromorphic and deep network workloads, as well as novel event-based computing approaches. For deep network workloads, the chip achieves up to 4.5 TOPS in high performance mode and up to 2.7 TOPS/W efficiency in high efficiency mode for INT8 workloads. The chip supports spiking neural networks with >150000 neurons and >1.8 billion synaptic events/s when simulated with a 1 ms time step. Its low baseline power of less than 250 mW allows for efficiency even under varying workload conditions, allowing to explore sparse and event-based modes of computation. All this demonstrates the chip's capabilities as a universal hardware platform for scalable brain-inspired computing and its combinations with mainstream deep network approaches.

At-the-Roofline Sparse Tensor Contractions on Vector Processors for Transformer Inference

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Bowen Wang, Chi Zhang, Diyou Shen, Renzo Andri, Navaneeth Kunhi Purayil, Luca Benini
high · 2026-07-28

Why it matters This work targets a concrete inference-kernel bottleneck: sparse gather-accumulate-scatter on vector processors. Its hardware support reaches 2.40–5.25× speedup for prefill and 2.06–3.16× for autoregressive decoding at 40–60% dual sparsity, while adding only 3.1% area to the vector cluster.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing RVV systems perform software index decoding and L1-backed indexed memory operations for moderately sparse weight-and-activation contractions.

02
Method

Ventaglio adds a runtime-configurable sparse execution unit and RVV extensions for indexed gather, accumulate, and scatter.

03
Difference

The design moves the core Gustavson dataflow operations into hardware instead of leaving them to software sparse kernels.

04
Evidence

A 12nm implementation, RTL-calibrated instruction-level model, and scale-out analysis are reported, with 6.9–7.4× kernel speedup over optimized RVV baselines.

Inference systems increasingly combine a fast path that returns predictions within the application's latency deadline together with a higher-accuracy slow path that runs higher-compute methods on stronger, remote hardware, so its results can be returned on time and combined with the fast path predictions. Across several application domains, we abstract this inference architecture as a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer with two functions: a router that invokes the slow path and a merger that decides whether to incorporate its returned predictions. In this work, we show that this new coordination layer exposes a new attack surface: shaped workload attacks, e.g., Yo-Yo bursts, can exploit contention at shared resources along the slow path to push benign users' slow-path predictions past their latency deadlines. The merger then discards those predictions, while the fast path continues to return timely outputs. We refer to the resulting loss of slow-path accuracy benefits as accuracy collapse. We demonstrate accuracy collapse in a two-tier edge-cloud multi-object tracking pipeline in autonomous driving. In simulation, approximately 4,000 burst-shaped requests increase benign p99 latency from 92ms to 2s, nearly eliminating the benefit of the slow path's cloud inference, reducing object tracking quality by 7.0 HOTA points on average. We further find that accuracy degradation can significantly vary (2.0-18.7 HOTA points), depending on the video intervals that are targeted in the attack, and that certain rare classes (e.g., stop signs) lose nearly half of their pre-attack prediction accuracy. These results show that workload attacks can degrade prediction quality without needing either access to model weights or victim data, and motivate research on attacks and defenses for routing, merging, scheduling, and resource isolation in these emerging inference pipeline architectures.

Why it matters The workflow moves LLM-assisted HLS from kernel generation toward a verifiable board-level loop, which matters for researchers building FPGA accelerators and hardware automation; its reported evidence includes synthesis, runtime, power, and failure signals, plus a reduction in six-message average text runtime from 207.3 ms to 52.4 ms on a post-quantum cryptography accelerator.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Natural-language-driven HLS can suffer from semantic mismatch, weak validation, and failure to close at the board level.

02
Method

The workflow uses Contract, HTML, and Hardware-in-the-Loop agents to translate requirements, preserve structured state, and revise designs from execution evidence.

03
Difference

Agents are split by semantic lowering and execution tasks rather than conversational roles, with board-level evidence included in the generation loop.

04

Abstract

This paper presents ContractHIL-HLS, a contract-aligned multi-agent workflow for practical high-level synthesis (HLS) engineering. The workflow makes three contributions. First, it introduces a structured contract as the semantic-alignment and task-execution artifact that translates natural language requirements into explicit interfaces, constraints, validation checks, and rollback rules. Second, it incorporates hardware information into the feedback loop by feeding HLS, Vivado, PYNQ runtime, power, and failure evidence back into generation, thereby extending LLM-assisted HLS from kernel code toward system- and board-level closure. Third, it decomposes agents by semantic lowering and execution tasks rather than by conversational roles: a Contract Agent lowers natural language into the contract, an HTML Agent renders the contract as persistent structured HTML, and a Hardware-in-the-Loop Agent implements and revises the design with measured evidence. We evaluate ContractHIL-HLS in two parts. On 94 locally executable HLS-Eval tasks, the structured contract provides the largest small design gain, improving the estimated single-sample testbench pass rate from 64.0% to 70.2%; the full flow reaches 70.4% pass@1 and 76.6% pass@5. Because HLS-Eval does not exercise board-level design, we also validate ContractHIL-HLS on a board tested ML-KEM/ML-DSA post-quantum cryptography (PQC) secure-message accelerator, where the retained dual-bitstream organization reduces six-message average text runtime from 207.3 ms to 52.4 ms with positive routed WNS on both images while preserving decrypted-message verification. We open-source our work at BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS (https://github.com/BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS).

Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation

Tzu-Heng Huang, Shengqi Qiu, Frederic Sala

Method brief
01
Problem

Per-sample LLM judges are costly, slow, and opaque.

02
Method

PAJAMA synthesizes a committee of judging programs, aggregates their verdicts, and falls back to an LLM for low-confidence cases.

03

Abstract

LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research

high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 它把深度研究从反复搜索改成“逐项验证—定位缺口—定向补查”的递归流程，并用自主上下文更新工具维持长程状态，适合需要同时满足多重约束且最终奖励稀疏的研究型代理。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 147）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

深度研究中的候选答案需要同时满足多个约束，但发现答案的成本高于逐约束验证。

02
方法

AREX交替运行收集证据并生成暂定答案的内层研究循环，以及审计约束、识别未决主张并触发补查的外层自改进循环。

03
差异

它训练代理自主压缩交互历史，保留已验证证据和未解决约束，而不是依赖外部模型管理长程上下文。

04
证据

作者在经验证的合成任务和高质量轨迹上进行代理中期训练与长程强化学习，并报告其在BrowseComp、WideSearch、DeepSearchQA和HLE等基准上超过同规模基线。

摘要

AREX是一组递归自改进的深度研究代理，通过内层证据搜集循环与外层逐约束审计循环反复修正答案，并针对未解决的主张开展后续研究。为支持长程递归改进，系统学习了无需外部模型的自主上下文更新工具，以压缩历史并保留已验证证据和未决约束；作者还结合代理中期训练、长程强化学习及关键证据步骤强化，在4B密集模型和122B-A10B混合专家模型上进行评估，报告其在多个研究、推理和工具使用基准上显著超过同规模基线。

空间智能对于智能体从静态语义理解走向物理世界交互至关重要，但现有基准常用坐标、选项或文本作为答案接口，与图像生成模型直接在像素空间表达空间判断的能力不匹配。论文提出协议化视觉评测框架及空间生成诊断基准，在统一设置下比较文本输出视觉语言模型和图像生成模型，结果显示图像生成模型在像素级表达空间答案时具有竞争力，而文本视觉语言模型在组合式空间推理上保持明显优势。

13
论文 / 补充信号

ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding

Hangjie Yuan, Yichen Qian, Zhiwei Tang, Xianzhe Xu, Lirong Wu, Sicheng Yang et al.
low · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 它主要解决医学影像多模态理解与临床评测，而非代理的规划或工具调用；只有在研究检索增强、工具辅助临床工作流时，才值得借鉴其视觉基础和区域级事实性评测。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 7）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

医学多模态模型需要统一理解异构二维与原生三维影像，并用符合放射科实践的细粒度、事实性指标评估输出。

02
方法

系统采用级联式组合视觉编码器和级联空间感知局部融合算子，并构建指令遵循与感兴趣区域对齐的报告评测框架。

03
差异

它把二维和三维医学影像纳入同一融合编码器，同时用视觉区域约束报告评估，而不是只依赖通用文本指标。

04
证据

作者报告其在二十四项基准中的二十项超过领先开源医学多模态模型，且放射科医生盲评和区域级指标相关性均表现最佳。

摘要

医学多模态模型在临床部署中面临以视觉为核心的挑战，包括异构二维和三维医学影像理解，以及符合放射科实践的指令遵循和事实性评估。本文提出临融系统，使用级联视觉编码器和空间感知局部融合算子统一影像理解，并通过医学指令遵循基准和感兴趣区域对齐的报告评测方法进行验证；作者报告其在多个医学基准上超过开源及部分专有模型，并可扩展到检索增强和工具辅助的临床工作流。

分类主题manipulation

high · 2026-07-28

方法解读
01
问题

研究目标是解决高保真且可规模化的操作示范稀缺问题，并检验无机器人数据能否独立支撑部署。

world-models.body:
01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题planning with world models

01
论文 / 高优先级

The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation

分类主题planning with world models
Tianyi Men, Zhuoran Jin, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
high · 2026-07-27

为什么值得看 它用可控的多轮环境把长程规划拆成能力获取、塑形和整合三个阶段，并显示显式状态转移世界模型、在策略蒸馏及多教师蒸馏如何影响跨任务泛化与干扰，为用世界模型训练代理提供了可检验的训练规律。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 21）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

互联网数据不可控且不透明，使长程规划能力的来源、塑形方式和整合过程难以分离研究。

02
方法

作者构建统一的可控多轮环境，并比较预训练数据、群组相对策略优化、在策略蒸馏和多教师在策略蒸馏的作用。

03
差异

方法将规划模式与任务知识区分开来，并分析不同环境中的共享、部分共享和冲突模式。

04
证据

摘要声称显式状态转移建模增强长程泛化，在低质量长程设置下在策略蒸馏比群组相对策略优化具有更广有效区间，而冲突模式会造成严重干扰。

摘要

论文在统一且可控的多轮环境中，系统研究长程规划在预训练、后训练塑形和能力整合三个阶段的形成机制。结果显示，显式世界模型式的思维链状态转移建模有助于长程泛化；在策略蒸馏在低质量和长程场景下比群组相对策略优化提供更稳定的更新方向；多教师在策略蒸馏可整合具有兼容规划模式的能力，但完全冲突的模式会导致严重干扰。

潜力 50新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
4 位作者1 所机构3 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models

分类主题planning with world models
Junhan Sun, Hao Zhao, Guofeng Zhang
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 它把通常需要测试时搜索的目标状态到动作过程变成可直接执行的条件动作分布，在四项任务上以零搜索达到百分之八十五点七八至百分之百成功率，并把可选搜索的候选序列采样量减少百分之九十六以上，适合关注低延迟规划和动作多样性的世界模型研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

前向潜变量世界模型能预测动作造成的场景变化，却通常要通过昂贵的测试时搜索反推出实现目标变化的动作。

02
方法

方法利用带动作标注的无奖励轨迹，把局部物理意图和未来目标意图输入具有相同四槽语法与共享参数的端到端联合嵌入预测架构，并学习条件动作分布。

03
差异

它通过同一预测器诱导的动作规律语义对齐局部与目标意图，而不要求潜变量逐点相等或动力学全局线性化。

04
证据

四项官方任务的一轮训练零搜索成功率分别为百分之八十五点七八、百分之百、百分之九十七点六七和百分之九十七点八九，直接推理耗时二点九至五点五毫秒。

摘要

INTACT从带动作标注的无奖励轨迹中学习局部物理意图与未来目标意图，并以结构同构、参数共享的联合嵌入预测架构建立从目标意图到动作的接口。其条件动作分布的均值可直接作为无需搜索的策略，采样则可用于增加多样性或进行可选验证；在四项官方任务上取得了较高的零搜索成功率，可选的局部交叉熵方法也用远少于纯搜索的候选序列获得更高的宏平均成功率。

潜力 38新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
3 位作者2 所机构2 条合作线
03
论文 / 高优先级

VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning

分类主题planning with world models
Jiaxin Bai, Jiaxuan Xiong
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 它把视觉状态和动作轨迹转化为可检查、可编辑且能滚动预测的动力学程序，使研究者在需要明确结构的导航与抓取规划中获得比现有代码世界模型高二十三点五个百分点的成功率，同时保留用真实引擎复核接触丰富计划的补救路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

连续向量动力学难以检查和编辑，而手工物理引擎又难以大规模构建。

02
方法

系统先用短时主动探测选择定性动力学形式，再从状态动作轨迹中拟合自由参数，并由场景图提供重规划时的视觉状态。

03
差异

它以源代码而非隐式神经表示承载动力学，并把程序直接用于模型预测控制。

04
证据

在多项比较中平均规划成功率达到百分之六十九，比最强代码基线高二十三点五个百分点，但接触密集的推动任务仍存在差距。

摘要

视觉补丁世界将世界动力学表示为代码：系统通过短时主动探测选择定性动力学形式，再以状态动作轨迹的多步预测误差拟合参数，使所得程序能够像模拟器一样前向运行、被检查，并用于模型预测控制。与既有代码世界模型相比，它取得百分之六十九的平均规划成功率并提升二十三点五个百分点；在导航和抓取控制中接近真实引擎表现，而接触密集的推动任务可通过用真实引擎复核候选计划来弥补大部分差距。

潜力 30新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
2 位作者1 所机构1 条合作线
04
论文 / 高优先级

Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control

分类主题planning with world models
Jiaxin Bai, Jiaxuan Xiong
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 它把离线轨迹中的时间顺序直接变成可部署的规划代价，缩小了潜在世界模型短期预测与多步目标排序之间的落差，并在双房间任务达到百分之百成功率、在立方体任务提升十四点二分，适合关注无奖励日志规划的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

潜在联合嵌入预测模型通常只学习短期表示预测，却依赖潜在欧氏距离为多步规划提供并非由任务进度监督得到的代价。

02
方法

方法保留编码器与预测器骨干，从无奖励轨迹的同轨迹步序、跨轨迹负样本和规划时域一致性中学习有向时间代价。

03
差异

学习到的时间代价既可在进度具有拓扑结构时直接用于规划，也能作为表示监督改善接触几何主导场景中的欧氏距离规划。

04
证据

锁定评测中双房间成功率从百分之九十七点四升至百分之百，立方体任务共享欧氏规划得分较基线提高十四点二分，并在推箱子任务上改善。

摘要

时间距离联合嵌入预测架构从无奖励离线轨迹中挖掘有向时间代价：同一轨迹的步序提供正目标，跨轨迹配对提供启发式负样本，滚动一致性项匹配规划时域。该代价既可直接作为规划成本，也可改善欧氏距离规划；锁定评测显示其在多个环境中达到或超过对比方法，并通过消融验证各组成部分的贡献。

潜力 30新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
2 位作者1 所机构1 条合作线
05
论文 / 高优先级

Schrödinger's Cat: Probabilistic Representation and Prediction of Potential Scene Kinematics

分类主题planning with world models
Timy Phan, Jannik Wiese, Björn Ommer
high · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 它用结构化运动潜变量直接表示并查询多种未来轨迹的分布，在保持与大型视频生成模型相当的运动规划表现下，将轨迹采样加速九十七倍、运动密度估计加速两个数量级，适合交互式和不确定性感知规划。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

从不完整观测预测场景演化时，单一轨迹无法表达多种可能未来，而现有方法通常偏向外观视频或少量轨迹采样。
